Innovation through formulation.

# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

[Visit the Customer Portal ][83]

.

### Sustainability

At Azelis, we are committed to maintaining high human, environmental and ethical values. That is
only possible thanks to the cooperation of local communities, industry bodies, authorities, and/or
regulators, and with you.* *
* [Our sustainability programme][84]
* [Our 2025 Integrated Report][85]
* [Our sustainability policies][8

Employment Opportunities
Working at Azelis

We embrace change as an invaluable opportunity to grow, learn and become even better at what we do.
As do our people. Azelis currently employs more than 4,100 talented individuals in 64 countries. And
counting.

## We are Azelis

Together with our 65,000+ customers we provide effective, sustainable and reliable business
solutions, developing innovative ways to create value. We are Azelis.

### Work with us

We currently employ more than 4,100 people across the world in 64 countries. We value highly
competent, forward-looking people.

Are you looking to work for a highly dynamic and innovative company where you can unleash your
talent? [Then you’re in the right place.][93]

[Discover our career opportunities][94]

### Corporate social responsibility

We take our responsibilities seriously and work with employees and stakeholders to reduce the
environmental impact of our work and to improve the social value in what we do, wherever we get the
opportunity.

***Against slavery and human trafficking***

We are committed to ensuring modern slavery does not take place within our business or supply
chains. 

[Learn more][95]
We provide high quality raw materials, sourced from leading global manufacturers. Our technical team
can provide you with sampling, formulation and expertise.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

What are others saying about our impact? With operations in 70 countries, Cargill and our customers

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used

manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]

][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

# CABB – Your Partner in Fine Chemistry

CABB Group is a leading contract development and manufacturing company (CDMO) for starting
materials, active ingredients and advanced intermediates. We specialize in the production of
customized, highly complex molecules for leading companies, particularly in crop sciences, life
sciences and performance materials industry.

[Watch the Video][129]

###### CUSTOM MANUFACTURING SERVICES

## Serving as an extension of your own operations

CABB Group offers fine chemical custom manufacturing services with a focus on complex, multi-step
chemical synthesis. We welcome customers from any industry requiring high-value starting materials,
advanced intermediates and active ingredients.

CABB’s track record of service is built upon a foundation of core competencies in fine chemistry and
unit operations, joined by an experienced leadership team dedicated to achieving customer success.

###### FINE CHEMICALS**
###### **

## Reagents, building blocks and advanced intermediates

CABB offers a select portfolio of fine chemicals, serving as starting materials or intermediates for
a variety of complex synthesis and formulation projects. Customers rely upon our quality and
exacting specifications for multiple downstream applications.

Products are sold on a made-to-order or made-to-demand basis, combining our manufacturing expertise
with those of our collaborative sourcing partners. Customers are welcome to provide forecasts and
delivery schedules for an easy buying experience.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

## Política de cookies

Las cookies son importantes para ti, influyen en tu experiencia de navegación, nos ayudan a proteger

cookies propias y de terceros para analizar nuestros servicios y mostrarte publicidad relacionada

páginas visitadas). Si consientes su instalación pulsa "Aceptar Cookies", o también puedes
configurar tus preferencias pulsando "Configurar Cookies".

## Panel de configuración de cookies

Al visitar este sitio web o mediante la utilización de la app móvil podemos utilizar y almacenar
información en tu navegador en forma de cookies. Estas incluyen información que es estrictamente
necesaria para el funcionamiento y la navegación por el sitio web y, por tanto, no pueden
desactivarse. Asimismo, se utilizan cookies de terceros para el seguimiento de tu navegación de
forma anónima con fines estadísticos y para poder ofrecerte publicidad personalizada basada en un
perfil elaborado a partir de tus hábitos de navegación. Como respetamos tu privacidad, mediante el
panel de configuración de cookies puedes aceptar o rechazar las cookies haciendo clic en la casilla
correspondiente. Para más información o para consultar el listado completo de cookies consulta
nuestra ["Política de cookies".][91]

su rendimiento. Toda la información que recogen estas cookies es agregada y, por lo tanto, es
anónima.

## Política de cookies

Las cookies son importantes para ti, influyen en tu experiencia de navegación, nos ayudan a proteger

cookies propias y de terceros para analizar nuestros servicios y mostrarte publicidad relacionada
con tus preferencias en base a un perfil elaborado con tus hábitos de navegación (por ejemplo,
páginas visitadas). Si consientes su instalación pulsa "Aceptar Cookies", o también puedes
configurar tus preferencias pulsando "Configurar Cookies".
Más información en nuestra ["Política de cookies".][88]

[Configurar Cookies][89] [Aceptar Cookies][90]

## Panel de configuración de cookies

Al visitar este sitio web o mediante la utilización de la app móvil podemos utilizar y almacenar
información en tu navegador en forma de cookies. Estas incluyen información que es estrictamente
necesaria para el funcionamiento y la navegación por el sitio web y, por tanto, no pueden
desactivarse. Asimismo, se utilizan cookies de terceros para el seguimiento de tu navegación de
forma anónima con fines estadísticos y para poder ofrecerte publicidad personalizada basada en un
perfil elaborado a partir de tus hábitos de navegación. Como respetamos tu privacidad, mediante el
panel de configuración de cookies puedes aceptar o rechazar las cookies haciendo clic en la casilla
correspondiente. Para más información o para consultar el listado completo de cookies consulta
nuestra ["Política de cookies".][91]

por el sitio web, así como para recordar las preferencias de cookies y, por lo tanto, no es posible

Cookies de rendimiento

Las cookies de rendimiento nos permiten conocer el nivel de recurrencia de nuestros visitantes y
realizar la medición y análisis estadístico de la utilización de nuestro servicio para poder mejorar
su rendimiento. Toda la información que recogen estas cookies es agregada y, por lo tanto, es
anónima.

# Global Sourcing Solutions

#### Do your current partnerships feel confining and restrictive?

DAXX is passionate about seeking new solutions, new routes and new relationships where others can’t
or won’t. DAXX is your global chemical partner for supply chain management, sourcing, blending and
distribution management.

> “Do not go where the path may lead.
> Go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.”
> 
> Ralph Waldo Emerson

For our Chemical Suppliers, Re-sellers and End-Users.

Since the early days of trade, various economic, political, and social factors have affected the
stability and efficiency of supply chains.

The globalization of trade and the rise of just-in-time inventory management have made supply chains
more vulnerable to disruptions, such as natural disasters, political instability, and cyberattacks.

Most recently, the COVID-19 pandemic of 2020-2021 highlighted the fragility of global supply chains.
It is certain, supply chains will be challenged again. From protective coatings and sealants to ag
chemical solutions, companies partner with DAXX because we excel during disruption.

#### Aging inventories

DAXX quickly adapts to supply chain disruptions, weather-related delays and other emergencies to
find products like ethyl methyl ketone, mipa, nonylphenol and other chemicals our clients need
urgently. Being dependable means our clients are better able to mitigate risks and respond to
unexpected market events.

DAXX is building a world where success is derived from perseverance, focus and undeniable
commitment. We apply these values every day to efficiently move inventories, reliably decrease
inventories and resolutely manage cash flows by

PERSEVERANCE

Perseverance is more important than just plain persistence, because it’s about having stamina and
endurance during the time of struggle. DAXX is relentless in finding solutions for our clients.

FOCUS

Focus is about producing a clear visual definition. DAXX listens to our clients so that we are clear
on what is important to them.

COMMITMENT

Commitment is about being dedicated to a cause. DAXX commits to our communities and our customers
above ourselves.

GROWTH MINDSET

A growth mindset is knowing that we can be better every day. DAXX instills a growth mindset in all
of our relationships.

When Others Can’t, We Can

Due to its motion, moving water possesses great amounts of energy. Just like a river or other body
of water, DAXX is always in motion. We bring unrivaled energy to every client we serve.

Since the early days of trade, various economic, political, and social factors have affected the
stability and efficiency of supply chains.

more vulnerable to disruptions, such as natural disasters, political instability, and cyberattacks.

Most recently, the COVID-19 pandemic of 2020-2021 highlighted the fragility of global supply chains.
It is certain, supply chains will be challenged again. From protective coatings and sealants to ag

and Young Leaders. The platform gives access to first-degree connects and knowledge content from
2800+ men and women of eminence across 26 domains (13 business and 13 lifestyle) to keep you ahead
of the curve.

proprietary DLC Channel, exclusive invites to DLC Events, access to exclusive Brand Collaborations,
and an opportunity to associate with member curated programs designed to create a meaningful Social
Impact.

[Learn more about DLC][107]

DLC is for Entrepreneurs and Young Leaders
who aspire to grow, connect, transform, and lead from the front to create future-fit organizations.

## Why DLC?

Leaders are lonely at the top and we want to challenge this status quo. It is our mission to create
a global community of Transformative Leaders. We believe DLC will be the catalyst to transform
leaders from

###### A Life of Success to a Life of Significance.

[Know more about DLC][106]

## What is DLC?

DLC is the World’s 1st Business Platform that offers a 360-degree support system for Entrepreneurs
and Young Leaders. The platform gives access to first-degree connects and knowledge content from
2800+ men and women of eminence across 26 domains (13 business and 13 lifestyle) to keep you ahead
of the curve.

DLC offers its members access to personalized Forum, access to peer-to-peer learning via its
proprietary DLC Channel, exclusive invites to DLC Events, access to exclusive Brand Collaborations,
and an opportunity to associate with member curated programs designed to create a meaningful Social
Impact.

[Learn more about DLC][107]

## Who is DLC for?

DLC is for Entrepreneurs and Young Leaders
who aspire to grow, connect, transform, and lead from the front to create future-fit organizations.

## **Excellence ****In ****Esters**

# **Who We Are**

At Esterchem, our mission is clear: to provide our customers with high-quality esters at competitive
prices, while prioritising sustainability and exceptional service.

With over 25 years of experience in the industry, we stand as a leading manufacturer of esters in
the UK.

We are committed to delivering innovative, sustainable solutions tailored to the unique needs of
your industry. Our focus on quality and customer satisfaction drives us to exceed expectations in
every aspect of our business.

Discover how Esterchem can support your business today.

[ About Us ][45]

# **Our Products**


As we continue to expand our production capacity, our product range is also growing. Our flexible
and close working relationships with existing and potential customers have led to many new
enquiries. The product you are looking for could be under development right now.

For information on products within each range, please follow the relevant ‘products’ section.
* ### Sorbitan Esters
  
  Our sorbitan esters are versatile and widely used across a variety of applications, enhancing the
  performance, functionality, and quality of products in a variety of industries. These esters
  provide reliable solutions, ensuring optimal results and meeting the highest standards for
  efficiency and effectiveness.
* ### PEG Esters
  
  These versatile compounds play a critical role in a wide range of applications, from personal care
  to industrial formulations. Discover how our PEG esters can elevate the performance and
  functionality of your products, catering to the diverse demands of your industry.
* ### Glyceryl Esters
  
  Our glyceryl esters are renowned for their emulsifying, moisturising, and stabilising properties.
  These multifunctional compounds are integral to enhancing the performance and texture of products
  across a wide range industries.
* ### Specialty Esters
  
  Our range of specialty esters are meticulously engineered to deliver superior performance and
  versatility. Each with variating properties, these esters are indispensable in various high-demand
  applications.
* ### Formates; Acetates; Propionates; Butyrates
  
  Our comprehensive range of formates, acetates, propionates, and butyrates offers exceptional
  functionality and versatility for a wide array of applications. Known for their solubility,
  reactivity, and stabilising properties, these compounds are essential in enhancing the performance
  of products across numerous industries.

[Esterchem Lab Distillation]

At Esterchem, our services have helped us specialise in the production and supply of high-quality
esters tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients across multiple industries and continents.
Our sustained commitment to excellence and innovation ensures that we deliver solutions that drive
success for your business.

# **Who We Are**

At Esterchem, our mission is clear: to provide our customers with high-quality esters at competitive
prices, while prioritising sustainability and exceptional service.

With over 25 years of experience in the industry, we stand as a leading manufacturer of esters in
the UK.

We are committed to delivering innovative, sustainable solutions tailored to the unique needs of
your industry. Our focus on quality and customer satisfaction drives us to exceed expectations in
every aspect of our business.

Discover how Esterchem can support your business today.

[ About Us ][45]

# **Our Products**


As we continue to expand our production capacity, our product range is also growing. Our flexible
and close working relationships with existing and potential customers have led to many new
enquiries. The product you are looking for could be under development right now.

For information on products within each range, please follow the relevant ‘products’ section.
* ### Sorbitan Esters
  
  Our sorbitan esters are versatile and widely used across a variety of applications, enhancing the
  performance, functionality, and quality of products in a variety of industries. These esters
  provide reliable solutions, ensuring optimal results and meeting the highest standards for
  efficiency and effectiveness.
* ### PEG Esters
  
  These versatile compounds play a critical role in a wide range of applications, from personal care
  to industrial formulations. Discover how our PEG esters can elevate the performance and
  functionality of your products, catering to the diverse demands of your industry.
* ### Glyceryl Esters
  
  Our glyceryl esters are renowned for their emulsifying, moisturising, and stabilising properties.
  These multifunctional compounds are integral to enhancing the performance and texture of products
  across a wide range industries.
* ### Specialty Esters
  
  Our range of specialty esters are meticulously engineered to deliver superior performance and
  versatility. Each with variating properties, these esters are indispensable in various high-demand
  applications.
* ### Formates; Acetates; Propionates; Butyrates
  
  Our comprehensive range of formates, acetates, propionates, and butyrates offers exceptional
  functionality and versatility for a wide array of applications. Known for their solubility,
  reactivity, and stabilising properties, these compounds are essential in enhancing the performance
  of products across numerous industries.

esters tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients across multiple industries and continents.
Our sustained commitment to excellence and innovation ensures that we deliver solutions that drive
success for your business.

EsterTec® sets a new standard for synthetic ester lubricant performance, based on an innovative
molecular design achieved via a unique production process.

Polyol esters derived from vicinal secondary diols deliver a new level of cost-effective efficiency.
Steric hindrance enhances oxidative stability, while secondary alcohols on adjacent carbons improve
hydrolytic stability. Experience unmatched performance and reliability by formulating with EsterTec
VSP esters for exceptional Value, Sustainability and Performance (VSP).

EsterTec offers superior cost-effective performance and environmentally acceptable lubricant (EAL)
advantages:

Natural Energy Efficiency

Enjoy low density and superior lubricity for enhanced energy efficiency.

Exceptional Stability

Benefit from best-in-class hydrolytic stability.

Optimal Heat Transfer

Experience excellent heat transfer and dielectric fluid properties.

Eco-Friendly Composition

Formulate with readily biodegradable, high-biogenic content.

Choose EsterTec for reliable, efficient, and sustainable performance.

# A sustainable future through innovative chemistry

##### Our vision is to become a sustainable world-class specialty chemicals company

With a vision to become a sustainable world-class specialty chemicals company, we deliver customer
value through innovative chemistry that supports the energy transition and drives sustainable
progress.

Our specialty chemicals reduce the impact of current transportation modes, enable e-mobility,
support decarbonisation, improve industrial efficiency and much more, helping our customers solve
complex challenges and succeed in a changing world.

### Customer Centric Innovation

We provide innovative solutions that solve the complex challenges faced by our customers today

[Explore our Customer Centric Innovation][48]

### Sustainability

Working with our value chain partners to achieve sustainability ambitions

[Learn about our Sustainability approach][49]

### Safety

Safety, Security and the Environment are our highest priorities

[Safety is our number one priority][50]

# About KLK OLEO

KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in
Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and
sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala
Lumpur Kepong Berhad][35], a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa
Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion
at the end of September 2025.

KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids,
Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as
Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse
end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I)
cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

# LineageOS Android Distribution

A free and open-source operating system for various devices, based on the Android mobile platform.

[Get LineageOS][9] [Blog][10]
[Home]

## Latest news

### [Summertime Updates!][11]

###### Exciting changes of all shapes and sizes are on their way!

calendar_today July 07, 2026 person_outline Inhishonor and Nolen Johnson

[A color wheel on top of several alternating squareblocks containing various images]

## Individuality

Customization is paramount to productivity.
That’s why LineageOS promises to push for user personalization and preference.

Everyone is unique and your device should be too.

[Two overlapping abstract screens, the left showing a Trust protocol notification and the right
showing a PIN input being scrambled to protect against memorization]

## Security

Your data, your rules. Along with monthly security updates to every supported device, we enhance
existing privacy touchpoints around the OS and keep you informed of how the system shares your data.


Trust helps you understand the state of your device's security and warns you about possible threats.

[A pinwheel of four devices each showing Lineage wallpapers]

## Longevity

LineageOS extends the functionality and lifespan of mobile devices from more than 20 different
manufacturers thanks to our open-source community of contributors from all around the world.

Want to contribute? [See how you can make LineageOS better][12].

[The LineageOS core app icons organized in a grid]

## Power to you

Our open-source apps are here to help you get through the day.

Want to do more with your device?
Power users will enjoy Unix command-line utilities.
Android developers will turn any device into the perfect device for apps development thanks to
enhanced tools and debugging capabilities.

## Ready? Get LineageOS now!

LineageOS, an open-source Android distribution, is available for several devices,
with more being continuously added thanks to the biggest, yet ever growing, Android open-source
community.
Join us and breathe new life in your device, be it old or new.

[Find your device][13]

modern society.

handle large volumes of business and provide our clients with high-quality materials. We are
concentrating on new downstream business, supported by a strong confidence in innovation and
thorough market research.

* To be a leader in providing quality oleochemicals and associated products by meeting customer
  needs through continuous improvement and sustained long-term growth in volume and profitability.

  derivatives. To keep abreast of technological developments in the fats & oils production and

* **Credibility & Integrity- **We maintain honesty, trustworthiness, and high ethical standards. We

possible by an internal operations and logistics team, as well as extensive customer and product
support. Our logistics and distribution network is extensive. Logistics: We have a dedicated
logistics and operations team that can manage the transportation of huge quantities of containers as
part of our distribution capabilities. Additionally, we have partnerships with the biggest and most
reputable international logistics firms, which enable us to transport materials around the world
with ease.

factories with state-of-the-art facilities that have been thoughtfully designed and built with
functionality in mind. To guarantee quality and worldwide supply continuity, we meticulously oversee
every step of the production, packaging, and logistics planning processes. Modern development labs
run by our manufacturers offer services for testing, product development, and custom formulations.
Our producers are prepared to create innovative goods or enhance the qualities of their current
models. At the heart of all we do is innovation.

We have a unique real-time insight of industry trends because to our extensive client base and
market research department. Understanding the markets they serve and the clients they represent is
the first step in developing a successful marketing plan. With a worldwide viewpoint, MSD worldwide

pricing and product offering, we support our observations with the viewpoints of industry experts.

qualities based on customer preferences by using a wide variety of oleochemicals.

cutting-edge technologies. Our manufacturer's quality advantage is a result of comprehensive testing
of incoming feedstock, computerized process modeling, state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment, and
diligent employees. Our top-tier quality processes are acknowledged by our esteemed clients
worldwide.

# Omya ranked #7 globally in chemical distribution

##### Our combined businesses, Omya Specialty Materials and Omya Performance Polymer Distribution,
##### are ranked 3rd in Europe and 7th globally in the 2025 ICIS top 100 chemical distributors
##### listing.

[Read more][248]
[Omya Specialty Materials Hero Image]

# Omya Specialty Materials

##### One-stop shop technical solutions for customers worldwide through the global distribution of
##### minerals and chemicals.

[Learn more about Omya Specialty Materials][249]
[Science Molecule DNA Model Structure, business teamwork concept 270524519]

# Omya Performance Polymer Distribution

##### Your global distribution partner for high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and
##### rubber polymers and additives.

[Discover Omya Performance Polymer Distribution][250]

## Our business units
* [
  
  ## Omya Specialty Materials
  
  Global sales and distribution for a wide range of specialist minerals, pigments, binders,
  additives, and life science ingredients.
  [OSM header]
  ][251]
* [
  
  ## Omya Performance Polymer Distribution
  
  Global distribution of high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and rubber polymers
  and additives.
  [OPPD_Header_image]
  ][252]

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

[Learn more about innovation][253]

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

[Explore our story][254]

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]
[Innovation]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

[Learn more][256]
[Sunlight in the green forest]

## Join the Omya team

With 9,000 people employed across more than 50 countries, Omya offers exceptional career
opportunities to talented individuals with the determination to succeed.

 

If you have a passion for minerals and chemistry, and would like to be part of our team, we’d love
to hear from you.

[See our job openings][257]
[Career opportunities at Omya]

### Omya facts and figures

At Omya, we take a long-term approach to business, ensuring sustainability and growth for both our
company and our customers. Here are some key facts and figures about Omya:

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

[Learn more about innovation][253]

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

[Explore our story][254]

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]
[Innovation]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

[Learn more][256]
[Sunlight in the green forest]

## Join the Omya team

With 9,000 people employed across more than 50 countries, Omya offers exceptional career
opportunities to talented individuals with the determination to succeed.

 

If you have a passion for minerals and chemistry, and would like to be part of our team, we’d love
to hear from you.

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

[LEARN MORE][20]

natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

## ACID - SALT - SULFIDE

ABOUT US

———    Shandong Pulisi Chemical Group

Founded in 2006, Shandong Pulisi Chemical Group is committed to providing high quality fine chemical
products and professional services to global customers. As a leading chemical supplier, we focus on
providing our customers with safe and reliable products and efficient and flexible supply chain
solutions.

**Core products and services**
We mainly supply formic acid, sodium formate, calcium formate, potassium formate and other products,
and also provide sodium sulfide, sodium hydrosulfide and other petroleum processing raw materials,
with SGS, BV, FAMI-QS and other international authoritative certification, to ensure quality, safety
and reliability, to meet the diversified needs of global customers.

**Supply chain and logistics advantages**
To ensure efficient delivery, we have set up warehousing bases in major ports such as Qingdao Port,
Tianjin Port and Longkou Port, and built a logistics network covering the whole country. With a
stable supply chain system, we are able to respond quickly to customer needs and ensure on-time
delivery of goods.

Shandong Pulisi Chemical Co., Ltd. was established in 2006 (Stock Code: 307785). The company focuses
on petrochemicals, mining chemicals, feed chemicals, and pharmaceutical chemicals. At present, the
company has established long-term and stable partnerships with Fortune Global 500 companies such as
China National Petroleum Corporation and Saint-Gobain. We always take customer demand as the core
orientation and provide tailored solutions to help customers strengthen their market
competitiveness.

The company has passed ISO9001:2015 Quality Management System Certification and German BV
Certification, and has been awarded multiple honors such as Foreign-Oriented Economic Enterprise,
Alibaba Demonstration Base, and Contribution Enterprise. In 2023, the company successfully went
public with stock code: 307785.

The company upholds the corporate culture philosophy of “Customer First, Rapid Response; Striving as
the Foundation, Efficient Collaboration; Integrity and Uprightness, Agile Adaptation.” We focus on
providing compliant and high-quality products and supporting services, and are committed to becoming
a long-term and stable partner for customers.

Meanwhile, the company has established mature warehousing and distribution systems at key logistics
hubs, including Qingdao Port, Tianjin Port, and Xinjiang border ports (Alashankou, Khorgos). We are
able to provide flexible supply solutions according to customer needs to ensure timely order
delivery. No matter where customers are located, Shandong Pulisi Chemical will safeguard their
business development with professional service systems and efficient response capabilities.

## ACID - SALT - SULFIDE

We have become the good partner with SINOPCE/CNPC/Saint-Gobain/BHP.

ABOUT US

———    Shandong Pulisi Chemical Group

Founded in 2006, Shandong Pulisi Chemical Group is committed to providing high quality fine chemical
products and professional services to global customers. As a leading chemical supplier, we focus on
providing our customers with safe and reliable products and efficient and flexible supply chain
solutions.

**Core products and services**
We mainly supply formic acid, sodium formate, calcium formate, potassium formate and other products,
and also provide sodium sulfide, sodium hydrosulfide and other petroleum processing raw materials,
with SGS, BV, FAMI-QS and other international authoritative certification, to ensure quality, safety
and reliability, to meet the diversified needs of global customers.

**Supply chain and logistics advantages**
To ensure efficient delivery, we have set up warehousing bases in major ports such as Qingdao Port,
Tianjin Port and Longkou Port, and built a logistics network covering the whole country. With a
stable supply chain system, we are able to respond quickly to customer needs and ensure on-time
delivery of goods.

Shandong Pulisi Chemical Co., Ltd. was established in 2006 (Stock Code: 307785). The company focuses
on petrochemicals, mining chemicals, feed chemicals, and pharmaceutical chemicals. At present, the
company has established long-term and stable partnerships with Fortune Global 500 companies such as
China National Petroleum Corporation and Saint-Gobain. We always take customer demand as the core
orientation and provide tailored solutions to help customers strengthen their market
competitiveness.

The company has passed ISO9001:2015 Quality Management System Certification and German BV
Certification, and has been awarded multiple honors such as Foreign-Oriented Economic Enterprise,
Alibaba Demonstration Base, and Contribution Enterprise. In 2023, the company successfully went
public with stock code: 307785.

The company upholds the corporate culture philosophy of “Customer First, Rapid Response; Striving as
the Foundation, Efficient Collaboration; Integrity and Uprightness, Agile Adaptation.” We focus on
providing compliant and high-quality products and supporting services, and are committed to becoming
a long-term and stable partner for customers.

Meanwhile, the company has established mature warehousing and distribution systems at key logistics
hubs, including Qingdao Port, Tianjin Port, and Xinjiang border ports (Alashankou, Khorgos). We are
able to provide flexible supply solutions according to customer needs to ensure timely order
delivery. No matter where customers are located, Shandong Pulisi Chemical will safeguard their
business development with professional service systems and efficient response capabilities.

## Welcome To Shreyans Chemicals

**Shreyans Chemicals **is a leading manufacturer & supplier of Esters in India. Started as a small
enterprise over **30 years** ago, we have come a long way in our endeavor to provide premium
products at economical prices.

While we are manufacturer and supplier of various Esters as per the requirement of our clients, our
primary products include **Ethyl Chloroacetate, Methyl Chloroacetate, Verdyl Acetate, Verdyl
Propionate**. Our product quality remains the best in class as quality is the prime focus for the
company.

Our state of the art manufacturing unit is based at **Tarapur MIDC**. We are strategically located
near the western coastline of India in order to cater to overseas clients. We specialize in
esterification reactions and can supply annual quantities exceeding 2000 tons for our products.
Also, with the plant site being only 50 km from the Indian financial capital, Mumbai, access to
global markets is convenient.

With a focus on innovation, we strive to use leading research and manufacturing practices and
provide products of premium quality. In the years to come, we intend to continue with our 30 year
old tradition of being among the leading manufacturers and suppliers of Esters.

# Experience our expertise

[OUR SUCROSE ESTERS][62]

Sisterna has been awarded the **Platinum Medal** by [EcoVadis][63] recognising our commitment to
Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).  This places us among the top 1% of companies worldwide
assessed by EcoVadis in terms of sustainability, ethics, and responsible business practices.

At Sisterna, we believe that sustainability is not just a goal—it’s a continuous journey. This
achievement reflects our dedication to responsible sourcing, environmental impact reduction, and
ethical business conduct.

[Our Corporate Social Responsibility][64]


[thumbnail]

## Food

Sisterna sucrose esters are used for numerous functions in food products. The basic function of
sucrose esters is emulsification but they are often chosen for their secondary functions. 

Sisterna sucrose oligo esters are applied in fat or oil based products such
as margarine and chocolate. Sucrose oligo esters can also be used a lubricant for tabletting.  

[Read More][65]

[thumbnail]

## Personal Care 

Sisterna sucrose esters are a unique range of high quality, non-ionic emulsiﬁers with an exceptional
performance and mildness to skin and eyes.

Sisterna sucrose esters can offer other unique beneﬁts to personal care formulations, thus offering
formulators many advantages in these times of environmental consciousness.

[Read More][66]

## Experience our sucrose esters

Sucrose esters are produced with sucrose, from beet and cane, and fatty acids from palm and coconut
oil. This enables them to be used as emulsifiers in virtually all food and personal care products.
Emulsifiers are substances that are able to mix two immiscible substances that normally do not mix,
for example water and oil and water and air (foam). Although sucrose esters are categorised as
emulsifiers, their functionality is not only emulsification.

[          Food        ][67] [Personal care][68]

[thumbnail]

## About Sisterna

Our aim is to be recognised as the ambassador and knowlegde provider for sucrose esters in our
market. Over the last 30 years we have developed numerous food as well as personal care applications
with our sucrose esters.

[About Sisterna][69]

[thumbnail]

## Our Specialists

Our team consists of two food engineers and two personal care specialists with over 65! years
experience in the food and personal care business. If you like to learn more about them:


[Sisterna Team][70]

[thumbnail]

## Our Sucrose Esters

Sisterna sucrose esters are a unique range of high quality, non-ionic emulsifiers with an
exceptional performance.  



[Our Sucrose Esters][71]

## Our commitment to sustainability

**Sustainability** **is a journey, not a destination.**

Sustainability is an important topic in our business, we are committed to remain a reliable supplier
for our customers and an attractive, safe and caring workplace for our employees.

Corporate Social Responsibility comes in many forms. Please find herewith an [overview][72] (CSR
Report) of our efforts.

[Learn more][73]

# Experience our expertise

[OUR SUCROSE ESTERS][62]

Sisterna has been awarded the **Platinum Medal** by [EcoVadis][63] recognising our commitment to
Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).  This places us among the top 1% of companies worldwide
assessed by EcoVadis in terms of sustainability, ethics, and responsible business practices.

At Sisterna, we believe that sustainability is not just a goal—it’s a continuous journey. This
achievement reflects our dedication to responsible sourcing, environmental impact reduction, and
ethical business conduct.

[Our Corporate Social Responsibility][64]


[thumbnail]

## Food

Sisterna sucrose esters are used for numerous functions in food products. The basic function of
sucrose esters is emulsification but they are often chosen for their secondary functions. 

Sisterna sucrose oligo esters are applied in fat or oil based products such
as margarine and chocolate. Sucrose oligo esters can also be used a lubricant for tabletting.  

[Read More][65]

[thumbnail]

## Personal Care 

Sisterna sucrose esters are a unique range of high quality, non-ionic emulsiﬁers with an exceptional
performance and mildness to skin and eyes.

Sisterna sucrose esters can offer other unique beneﬁts to personal care formulations, thus offering
formulators many advantages in these times of environmental consciousness.

[Read More][66]

## Experience our sucrose esters

Sucrose esters are produced with sucrose, from beet and cane, and fatty acids from palm and coconut
oil. This enables them to be used as emulsifiers in virtually all food and personal care products.
Emulsifiers are substances that are able to mix two immiscible substances that normally do not mix,
for example water and oil and water and air (foam). Although sucrose esters are categorised as
emulsifiers, their functionality is not only emulsification.

[          Food        ][67] [Personal care][68]

[thumbnail]

## About Sisterna

Our aim is to be recognised as the ambassador and knowlegde provider for sucrose esters in our
market. Over the last 30 years we have developed numerous food as well as personal care applications
with our sucrose esters.

[About Sisterna][69]

[thumbnail]

## Our Specialists

Our team consists of two food engineers and two personal care specialists with over 65! years
experience in the food and personal care business. If you like to learn more about them:


[Sisterna Team][70]

[thumbnail]

## Our Sucrose Esters

Sisterna sucrose esters are a unique range of high quality, non-ionic emulsifiers with an
exceptional performance.  



[Our Sucrose Esters][71]

## Our commitment to sustainability

**Sustainability** **is a journey, not a destination.**

Sustainability is an important topic in our business, we are committed to remain a reliable supplier
for our customers and an attractive, safe and caring workplace for our employees.

Corporate Social Responsibility comes in many forms. Please find herewith an [overview][72] (CSR
Report) of our efforts.

[Learn more][73]

## Industrial Consultant and Manufacturing Consultant:

### Key to Your Business Success

In the ever-evolving world of manufacturing, the roles of an industrial consultant and a
manufacturing consultant are indispensable. These professionals bring a wealth of knowledge and
expertise, helping businesses navigate challenges, improve efficiencies, and stay ahead of the
competition. Manufacturing consulting services encompass a wide range of support, from optimizing
production processes to implementing innovative technologies. These services are crucial for
companies looking to streamline operations, reduce costs, and increase productivity. Industrial
consultants in India are particularly adept at understanding the unique challenges of the Indian
manufacturing landscape, including regulatory compliance, supply chain complexities, and market
dynamics.

An industrial consultant offers strategic advice on enhancing operational efficiency, ensuring that
all aspects of the manufacturing process are optimized. They provide insights into best practices,
help implement new technologies, and develop strategies to overcome production bottlenecks. Their
role is to ensure that manufacturing operations run smoothly and efficiently, ultimately
contributing to the business profitability and growth.

Manufacturing consultants, on the other hand, focus on production technical and practical aspects.
Every detail, from machinery selection to workflow design, is meticulously planned and executed by
them as part of the manufacturing plant setup process. Manufacturing plant consultants offer design
services that enable businesses to meet growing demands and market changes while maximizing
efficiency and scalability. Manufacturing consulting services also include advising on compliance
with industry standards and regulations, which is critical for avoiding costly penalties and
ensuring smooth operations. Industrial consultants in India are well-versed in local regulations and
can guide businesses through the complexities of compliance, making them valuable partners in the
Indian manufacturing sector.

By leveraging the expertise of industrial and manufacturing consultants, businesses can improve
their manufacturing processes significantly. It is their guidance that can help companies succeed in
a competitive market, enhancing efficiency, reducing costs, and driving innovation. In a competitive
market, their guidance can be instrumental.

## Industrial Consultant and Manufacturing Consultant:

### Key to Your Business Success

In the ever-evolving world of manufacturing, the roles of an industrial consultant and a
manufacturing consultant are indispensable. These professionals bring a wealth of knowledge and
expertise, helping businesses navigate challenges, improve efficiencies, and stay ahead of the
competition. Manufacturing consulting services encompass a wide range of support, from optimizing
production processes to implementing innovative technologies. These services are crucial for
companies looking to streamline operations, reduce costs, and increase productivity. Industrial
consultants in India are particularly adept at understanding the unique challenges of the Indian
manufacturing landscape, including regulatory compliance, supply chain complexities, and market
dynamics.

An industrial consultant offers strategic advice on enhancing operational efficiency, ensuring that
all aspects of the manufacturing process are optimized. They provide insights into best practices,
help implement new technologies, and develop strategies to overcome production bottlenecks. Their
role is to ensure that manufacturing operations run smoothly and efficiently, ultimately
contributing to the business profitability and growth.

Manufacturing consultants, on the other hand, focus on production technical and practical aspects.
Every detail, from machinery selection to workflow design, is meticulously planned and executed by
them as part of the manufacturing plant setup process. Manufacturing plant consultants offer design
services that enable businesses to meet growing demands and market changes while maximizing
efficiency and scalability. Manufacturing consulting services also include advising on compliance
with industry standards and regulations, which is critical for avoiding costly penalties and
ensuring smooth operations. Industrial consultants in India are well-versed in local regulations and
can guide businesses through the complexities of compliance, making them valuable partners in the
Indian manufacturing sector.

By leveraging the expertise of industrial and manufacturing consultants, businesses can improve
their manufacturing processes significantly. It is their guidance that can help companies succeed in
a competitive market, enhancing efficiency, reducing costs, and driving innovation. In a competitive
market, their guidance can be instrumental.

antifreeze, brake fluids and aircraft de-icing fluids in Europe. From our state-of-the-art,

Solventis is also a major producer of aircraft de-icing fluids through our subsidiary [Kilfrost
Europe][25].  These products are produced in-house in our bespoke facility in Antwerp.

Our specialist export division operates alongside and delivers high-quality chemicals to customers
in Africa, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia. [Learn more about your chemical solvent
supplier][26].

Our specialist export division operates alongside and delivers high-quality chemicals to customers
in Africa, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia. [Learn more about your chemical solvent
supplier][26].

**About Somu Organo Chem Pvt. Ltd.**

We are an ISO 9001:2004, ISO 14001:2000 and OSHAS 18001 Certified manufacturer, supplier and
exporter of varieties of Pharmaceutical Chemicals, Pharma Ingredients, Fine Chemicals and
Nutraceutical Products. Having favorable credit rating by CRISIL, we are a subsidiary company of the
prestigious Somu Group. Our remarkable array of Pharmaceutical Chemicals or Pharma Ingredients
include N-Butyl Propionate, 4 Hydroxy Carbazole, Tetrahydro Curcuminoids, 4-N Hexyl Resorcinol, etc.
Our major export markets are Australia, China, United Kingdom, Japan and United States. Advanced
chemical processing techniques are utilized in the manufacturing of our products.

We mainly supply our Solvents to the manufacturer of Paints, Coating, Printing Ink & Leather
Lacquers and also many more industries.

Our professionals are continuously engaged in making chemical products to specific client needs and
creating new formulations in order to meet the ever-changing demands of the global market. We have
been able to scale new heights of success with the help of superior quality chemicals, unsurpassed
experience, state of the art infrastructure, and dedication towards our clients. Our infrastructure
is large and completely reliable in supporting our entire manufacturing process. Hi-tech machines
are installed in the production units to deliver products at fast pace and without any defects. Our
R&D unit is equipped with advanced tools and equipment for the quality enhancement of our products
like Pharmaceutical Chemicals, Pharma Ingredients, etc.

**Primary Competitive Advantages**

We have been in this field from a very long time and have various specialties that make us surpass
our clients in terms of production, quality and client satisfaction. Some of the factors that stand
up apart from other companies are as follows:

* Customized Products
* Focus on Feedback, Follow-up & Delivery
* Scale Up and Process Development
* Customer's Confidentiality Maintained
* Implementation of Advanced technology
* Client-centric Approaches

**Quality Confirmation**

Our long-term relationships with clients is a result of our adherence to the stringent quality
standards. Our products like Pharmaceutical Chemicals, Pharma Ingredients, Agrochemical
Intermediates, Cosmetic Intermediates, etc are formulated in compliance with ISO and OHSAS
standards. We upholds our commitment to the chemical quality and client satisfaction. Our quality
experts rigorously examine the entire chemical produced N-Butyl Propionate, Coleus Forskolin, 4-N
Butyl Resorcinol, 13-Cyclohexane Dione, Tetrahydro Curcuminoids, etc. with the help of latest
testing equipment. Our products like Agrochemical Intermediates, etc are tested on the parameters of
formulation, composition, pH value, color, toxicity, etc.

**Main Products**

We are a manufacturer, supplier and exporter of the following products:

* N-Butyl Propionate
* Coleus Forskolin
* Benzal Konium Chloride
* Tetrahydropiperine
* Tetrahydro Curcuminoids
* Curcuminoids
* 13-Cyclohexane Dione

**Application Areas**

* Pharma intermediates
* Agrochemical Intermediates
* Cosmetic intermediates
* Coatings
* Paint intermediates

**Our Infrastructure**

We have developed a state-of-the-art infrastructural set-up at an industrial Area, which allows us
to carry out the business operations promptly and effectively. Our infrastructure facility is
installed with advanced technologies and computerized hardware & software facilities. Further, the
plant is well-connected to all the transportation network that helps in delivering the order to
major destination of the country as well as across the globe. With a vast infrastructure, we have
been able to meet the distinct chemical requirements of the clients in an efficient manner.

**Group of Companies**

We, Somu Organo Chem Pvt. Ltd., are a part of renowned Somu Group, which is also a parent firm of
following prestigious enterprises:

* Somu & Co.
* Somu Solvents Pvt. Ltd.
* Somu Organo-Chem Pvt. Ltd.
* Somu Educational Services Pvt. Ltd.
* Solvents & Chemicals Co.
