**About Somu Organo Chem Pvt. Ltd.**

We are an ISO 9001:2004, ISO 14001:2000 and OSHAS 18001 Certified manufacturer, supplier and
exporter of varieties of Pharmaceutical Chemicals, Pharma Ingredients, Fine Chemicals and
Nutraceutical Products. Having favorable credit rating by CRISIL, we are a subsidiary company of the
prestigious Somu Group. Our remarkable array of Pharmaceutical Chemicals or Pharma Ingredients
include N-Butyl Propionate, 4 Hydroxy Carbazole, Tetrahydro Curcuminoids, 4-N Hexyl Resorcinol, etc.
Our major export markets are Australia, China, United Kingdom, Japan and United States. Advanced
chemical processing techniques are utilized in the manufacturing of our products.

We mainly supply our Solvents to the manufacturer of Paints, Coating, Printing Ink & Leather
Lacquers and also many more industries.

Our professionals are continuously engaged in making chemical products to specific client needs and
creating new formulations in order to meet the ever-changing demands of the global market. We have
been able to scale new heights of success with the help of superior quality chemicals, unsurpassed
experience, state of the art infrastructure, and dedication towards our clients. Our infrastructure
is large and completely reliable in supporting our entire manufacturing process. Hi-tech machines
are installed in the production units to deliver products at fast pace and without any defects. Our
R&D unit is equipped with advanced tools and equipment for the quality enhancement of our products
like Pharmaceutical Chemicals, Pharma Ingredients, etc.

**Primary Competitive Advantages**

We have been in this field from a very long time and have various specialties that make us surpass
our clients in terms of production, quality and client satisfaction. Some of the factors that stand
up apart from other companies are as follows:

* Customized Products
* Focus on Feedback, Follow-up & Delivery
* Scale Up and Process Development
* Customer's Confidentiality Maintained
* Implementation of Advanced technology
* Client-centric Approaches

**Quality Confirmation**

Our long-term relationships with clients is a result of our adherence to the stringent quality
standards. Our products like Pharmaceutical Chemicals, Pharma Ingredients, Agrochemical
Intermediates, Cosmetic Intermediates, etc are formulated in compliance with ISO and OHSAS
standards. We upholds our commitment to the chemical quality and client satisfaction. Our quality
experts rigorously examine the entire chemical produced N-Butyl Propionate, Coleus Forskolin, 4-N
Butyl Resorcinol, 13-Cyclohexane Dione, Tetrahydro Curcuminoids, etc. with the help of latest
testing equipment. Our products like Agrochemical Intermediates, etc are tested on the parameters of
formulation, composition, pH value, color, toxicity, etc.

We are a manufacturer, supplier and exporter of the following products:

* N-Butyl Propionate
* Coleus Forskolin
* Benzal Konium Chloride
* Tetrahydropiperine
* Tetrahydro Curcuminoids
* Curcuminoids
* 13-Cyclohexane Dione

**Application Areas**

* Pharma intermediates
* Agrochemical Intermediates
* Cosmetic intermediates
* Coatings
* Paint intermediates

**Our Infrastructure**

We have developed a state-of-the-art infrastructural set-up at an industrial Area, which allows us
to carry out the business operations promptly and effectively. Our infrastructure facility is
installed with advanced technologies and computerized hardware & software facilities. Further, the
plant is well-connected to all the transportation network that helps in delivering the order to
major destination of the country as well as across the globe. With a vast infrastructure, we have
been able to meet the distinct chemical requirements of the clients in an efficient manner.

We, Somu Organo Chem Pvt. Ltd., are a part of renowned Somu Group, which is also a parent firm of

Our low price promise backed up with a $1000 guarantee; ask your salesperson about this offering! [Read More][74] #### We Travel Everywhere Our Weigh-Tec crew has few limitations on where we can go. We have installed scales and scale foundations throughout the entire U.S. and even abroad. From Fresno, California to Port Everglades, Florida; from Cuba to Guatemala, we have seen it all. Our greatest asset is our experience. We will lead you to a successful project in a timely manner. [Read More][76] #### Best Product, Best Service, Best Price Being a growing small business, we have the ability to provide top quality products, irreplaceable services, and the best prices to get 100% customer satisfaction. [Read More][77] ### Truck and Rail Scales #### Truck Scales A truck scale can be the most vital piece of equipment for many different types of businesses, truly becoming your “cash register” as you weigh product. A heavy duty, properly set-up, well maintained truck scale can last for a generation. [View Truck Scales][78] #### Rail Scales When selecting a complete line of rail weighing equipment, Weigh-Tec can exceed your requirements. We are an authorized representative of many leading manufacturers that produce in-motion scales, dual draft static scales, and more. [View Rail Scales][79] #### Specialty Scales For those with unique needs, Weigh-Tec can provide lightning protection, pallet scales, lift truck scales, bench and counting scales, floor scales, livestock scales, and more. Give us a call for an estimate to get started on your specialty project today. [Contact Us][80] #### Who We Are Weigh-Tec was founded in 1994 by Dale Cook, who is still running the business 26 years later. Being a family-owned company, we care about every customer’s satisfaction and put everything we have into each and every job. We are a full-service industrial scale company whose driving purpose is customer service. Our technicians are trained and experienced with the most intricate, analytical lab balances all the way to the multi-ton railroad, truck, and crane scale. We maintain multiple test trucks with accurate, certified weights. We have a fleet of service vehicles ready for dispatch 24 hours a day and a 24-hour on-call service team. Our company represents a wide variety of manufactures whose reputations speak for themselves such as B-TEK, Cardinal, DIGI, FlexWeigh, Ohaus, Rice Lake, and SAI. Weigh-Tec can handle all your scale needs, whether it’s servicing and maintaining your existing equipment or coordinating future improvements. For more detailed information about our sales and service opportunities, please call or fill out our form above for more information.
